subject: Welcome to Berk
body:
Is this thing working? The ants say it is. RIGHT. Welcome to Berk, apprentice, or one of its many lovely villages. I'm Gobber. I make the axes, mend the shields and teach the young ones dragons, and I've only lost two of them. Students, I mean. Limbs is also two. Find yourself a wild dragon, keep your hands empty, and try to scream only on the inside.

Gobber
